name: – Konstantinos Arvanitis – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: REPORT on the Commission’s 2025 Rule of Law report
part_text:
**What this report asks for**

This is the European Parliament's response to the European Commission's 2025 review of the rule of law in EU countries. It is an opinion, not a law, so nothing changes automatically. It asks for courts to be independent, corruption to be prosecuted properly, journalists and civil society to be protected, and EU money to be withheld from countries that break these rules. It also asks the Commission to improve how it reports each year.

**Key points**

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament sets out demands and asks the Commission and Council to act on them.
- **Who it affects:** EU governments, judges, journalists, civil society groups, and anyone relying on fair courts.
- **What happens next:** The Commission and Council are asked to respond and to use existing tools, including holding back EU funds.
